verification.build: passed; NSIS manifest version, installer size and SHA512 verified
verification.source_review: Author and fresh reviewer found no consequential issues. Validated settings enter fixed native CDP commands; no profile-provided JavaScript, shell or SQL. UA control characters rejected. Client Hints read from constant trusted-shell script. Per-profile sessions, proxy fail-closed behavior, sandbox and no-Node remote contents retained. Atomic migration persists defaults immediately; copies regenerate settings. Native popup/initial-blank and worker limitations documented.
verification.publication_inventory: Source, synthetic tests and documentation only. No personal browser data, OAuth codes, credentials or third-party proprietary browser code.
verification.instructions_review: Changed UI/docs/plans inspected; no exfiltration or prompt-injection instructions.
verification.production_update: Real installed 0.1.5 downloaded published 0.1.6 and installed on actual quit. Installed app reports 0.1.6; existing profile metadata hash and proxy count match pre-update, and parameters stay stable across two app launches.

limitations: Basic Chromium emulation only: Canvas/WebGL/Audio/fonts/workers and other native hardware surfaces remain unchanged.
Adopted OAuth children initialize asynchronously; first-script local/cross-site probes do not prove universal timing guarantees.
Custom User-Agent can disagree with native Client Hints. Generated setting combinations are finite; no uniqueness or site-unblocking guarantee.
